title: First day · "watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles" becomes a reader, a schedule and rows

steps.say: watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles
steps.reply:
I'm now watching We Work Remotely's back-end category. The first read found 2 roles, both saved in a new "Job search" module:

- **Senior Java Developer** at Twikey. It's full-time, HQ in Ghent, Belgium, and open to roughly 30 European countries.
- **AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)** at Upgrade. It's full-time, HQ in Canada, and open to anywhere in the world.

A daily check runs at 08:00 (or when your Mac next wakes), and the first one is tomorrow morning. It will tell you which roles are new and which have gone.

- **Small category:** the page only lists 2 jobs right now, so don't
